name: Astrid Bjornstad
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While pursuing a degree in Computer Science at NTNU, she volunteered to help a local racing team with their data analysis systems. Her knack for streamlining complex IT infrastructure and improving data flow quickly became apparent. She left university early after receiving a job offer from AF Corse. 

Astrid thrives on the high-pressure environment of racing. Her pragmatic approach ensures that the team's IT systems are always reliable and efficient. She is known for her ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues, even under tight deadlines. Astrid views herself as a support system, ensuring that everyone has the tools they need to perform to the best of their ability. Her youth and eagerness to learn sets her apart, as well as her ability to explain complex IT concepts in simple terms to other team members.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often tucked behind her ears.
physical.description: Astrid is petite with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn multi-tool.
Prefers to communicate via concise, bullet-pointed emails.
Has an uncanny ability to remember IP addresses and server locations.
